systems.system: Proposed link of the Education Management Information System to eCRVS and eID through an Identity Bus
systems.platform: eCRVS (WCC HERA) and eID, Identity Bus
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Ministry of Interior and MOCDE under an MoU
systems.tiers: proposed or under way in 2025; the diagnostic says EMIS and the identity systems operate in silos

note: Says only that the eMIS manages education sector data for planning and monitoring, with no common identifier and duplicate entries; it does not say what schools enter or when, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
